name: PsiBot
summary:
PsiBot develops embodied AI for dexterous physical manipulation. Founded in 2024, the company combines robot platforms, end-to-end learning models and real-world data collection to improve how robots handle objects and carry out tasks. Its research includes a joint laboratory with Peking University.

The company's PSI model work is supported by PsiSynEngine, a system for collecting and using physical interaction data. Its public materials describe early application validation in logistics and warehouse settings. The focus is on connecting learned perception and decision-making with reliable actions, using operating experience to improve manipulation across different tasks and environments.
